teaser: You are mid-sentence, sketching a plan on a napkin before the waiter clears the first round, and that is life path 22 meeting an ENTP head-on. The 22 is called the Master Builder, carrying the vision of an 11 and the muscle of a 4 — a number that asks for something built at scale, built to last. An ENTP meets that demand with a mind built for angles, not for laying brick. What is particular here is the gap between the size of what you can imagine and the patience it takes to finish any one piece of it.
excerpt: Three unfinished proposals sit in the same inbox as an anniversary reminder you almost missed.
